integrity: The all-dimensional proof is geometric and linear-algebraic, with a reproducible standard-library checker. Independently validated status is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The finite Hu--Ivaki facet network is studied, not the smooth centro-affine spectrum. No bound on indecomposable factors or local-minimality claim is established. Finite checks corroborate the exact proof, without certifying all dimensions. Historical originality has residual risk of an unindexed weighted-join formulation.
title: Exact Cartesian-product rule for the polyhedral centro-affine even spectrum
